metrics.timingNote: Wall time includes model-capacity interruptions and eleven resumed turns, so authoring duration is not comparable to an uninterrupted run.

independentValidation.finding: The data workflow is correct online and offline, but RAYONS and the scalar path render after the product grid instead of as top navigation.

genericCorrection.problem: UpdateList kept object values at runtime but did not propagate their schema into an iterator, and a clear action could overwrite a richer schema for the same target.
genericCorrection.result: The live Run5 picker now exposes executable bindings for breadcrumb[0].name, breadcrumb[0].levelId and breadcrumb[0].sourceBreadcrumb after append and clear actions.
genericCorrection.run5Policy: The catalog, breadcrumb and detail authoring remain the fresh-agent output. Only the root startup lifecycle was corrected after the persistent-browser defect was reproduced.

persistentSyncCorrection.problem: The generated application used a continuous FullSync sync operation. A persistent browser could remain in the active 100/100 state and never execute the following navigation.
persistentSyncCorrection.correction: Use a one-shot pull for the read-only catalog, reset incompatible local checkpoints once with marker retailstore-v4-pull, then query the local view explicitly to build its index before navigating.
persistentSyncCorrection.progressUi: Status now accepts a generic loadingImage property. Run5 uses the original init.gif, sync.gif and optimize.gif assets for the three observable stages.
persistentSyncCorrection.validation: Local and beta campaigns both pass the complete online/offline workflow and two consecutive starts with the same persistent FullSync profile.

betaDeployment.browserValidation: 1/1 passed in 25.0s, including strict offline navigation with zero fetch/XHR

betaPersistentSyncDeployment.browserValidation: 2/2 passed in 38.0s: complete online/offline workflow and two starts with one persistent FullSync profile.

remainingGaps.behavior: Run5 displays one RAYONS command and a scalar path after the grids; intermediate segments are not actionable.
remainingGaps.next: Use the corrected UpdateList schema picker in the next fresh run and place the breadcrumb before catalog content.

remainingGaps.behavior: Image.source has no directly executable literal candidate; the agent had to construct the standard literal binding for project fixture URLs.
remainingGaps.next: Expose literal binding mutations and safe project asset choices through the frontend picker.

remainingGaps.behavior: flow-app-progress reports 100 percent while presentation nodes can retain duplicate palette default ids.
remainingGaps.next: Generate unique ids or report duplicate ids before the next fresh campaign.
